fields.FIR_Description: As per the complaint recorded on 2025-09-26, Rajesh Mani, aged 20, a college student, did not return after leaving for a temple visit; last known location was near Sevvanthi Park Shopping Complex. The time of the incident was given as 17:10 on 2025-09-26. The complaint was lodged by Divya Devi (9000000287), a family member of Rajesh Mani, whose last active mobile number is noted as 9000000409. No identifying details of the suspected person were available at the time of registration. Tamilarasan Selvam was mentioned as a person who was present nearby, but no contact number was available. Murugan Sundaram (9000000207), described as a friend of the suspect, was also mentioned in the complaint. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage and photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Mobile phone allegedly switched off shortly after leaving the campus area.
fields.Keywords: missing person, student, evening, witness, photograph, shopping complex, CCTV, associate
